{{recipesummary|category=Sauce recipes|servings=8 to 10|time=2 hours|difficulty=1}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Southern cuisine|Southern U.S. cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Holiday Recipes|Mardi Gras Recipes]]
==Ingredients==

* 1 jar (12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) of refrigerated chunky blue cheese dressing
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] Creole [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]]
* ⅓ cup [[Cookbook:Scallion|scallions]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] (reserve a teaspoon of chopped green tops for [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]])
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] Creole seasoning

==Procedure==

# Combine all ingredients and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving (overnight is preferable).
# Garnish with the reserved scallions.

==Notes, tips and variations==

* Serve as a dipping sauce for celery stalks and cooked [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken wings]] (baked, broiled, fried, or grilled), 24 pieces of wings (tips discarded) or "drummettes" for the quantities given.
* Can use with any other raw vegetable.
